C. Water supply systems and sanitary sewage systems shall be designed to preclude infiltration of flood waters into the systems and discharges from the system into flood waters.
D. All gas and oil supply systems shall be designed to preclude the infiltration of flood waters into the systems and discharges from the systems into flood waters. Additional provisions shall be made for the drainage of these systems in the event that flood water infiltration occurs.
1.8 Paints and Adhesives
A. Adhesives used at or below the 1st floor level shall have a bonding strength that is unaffected by inundation.
B. Doors and all wood trim at or below the lst floor level shall be sealed with a waterproof paint or similar product.
C. Paints or other finishes used at or below the first floor level shall be capable of surviving inundation.
1.9 Storage
A. No materials that are buoyant, flammable, explosive or in times of flooding, could be injurious to human, animal, or plant life, shall be stored below an elevation one (1) foot above the elevation of the one hundred (100) year flood.
